instruction: Send the draft I wrote to Marco.
final_text:
I sent your draft to Marco Bianchi (marco@verdant.example) as a reply in the "Re: Renewal pricing" thread. It went exactly as you wrote it:

> "Hi Marco, we can't do 20%, but we can offer 10% on a two-year commitment. Let me know if that works. Best, Sam"

Before sending, I checked the thread. His email from yesterday asking for 20% off a two-year commitment was still the latest message, so your reply was still current.

Your other draft, the pilot scope email to Priya Shah, is still saved and hasn't been sent.
